mission: Implement kiosk cash-at-counter lifecycle with NF525 guard, POS collection actions, KDS pending-payment visibility, outbox eventing, and regression tests.

gates.HG_FROZEN_ORDERSERVICE_UNLOCK: approved in source plan for one strict B5b hunk/service
gates.fiscal_kiosk_scope: counter-deferred orders must not allocate fiscal_sequence_no until POS collection

business_decisions.kiosk_cash: order is created and sent to KDS as payment pending at counter
business_decisions.pos_confirm: allocates fiscal sequence and creates payment transaction
business_decisions.pos_cancel: cancels order, releases stock via OrderCanceled, never allocates fiscal sequence

invariants: branch isolation is enforced by route model scope and service guard
OrderService and FrontendOrderService parity was considered
no frontend price authority was introduced
